en.description:
Cats take the wheel in Cat Kart, a fast 3D kart racer made for Apple Watch.

Pick your cat, line up on the grid and race three laps against five rivals. Slide through corners to charge a mini-turbo, grab item boxes and fight your way to the front before the checkered flag.

SIX CATS, SIX DRIVING STYLES
Whiskers the all-rounder, speedy Nala, nimble Mochi, quick-starting Luna, steady Pippa and heavyweight Lilo. Every cat has its own speed, acceleration, grip and weight.

THREE THEMED TRACKS
Race through sunny Whisker Meadow, the golden Litter Dunes at sunset and the Moonlit Rooftops at night.

DRIFT AND BOOST
Hold a drift and watch the sparks turn from blue to orange to purple. Let go at the right moment for a powerful mini-turbo. Boost pads on every track add extra speed.

CAT ITEMS
Fish Boost for a burst of speed, a Yarn Ball that rolls down the track, a Wind-up Mouse that chases the racer ahead, a sneaky Hairball trap and Catnip for a few seconds of unstoppable speed.

GRAND PRIX OR SINGLE RACE
Race all three tracks in the Whisker Cup and collect points for every finish, or pick your favourite track for a quick single race.

MADE FOR YOUR WRIST
Steer by sliding your finger, drift with a second finger and feel every boost, bump and lap through haptic feedback. Races last about a minute, perfect for a short break.

EXTRA TOUCHES
Original chiptune soundtrack, switchable at any time. Pauses automatically when you lower your wrist. Works completely offline, runs right on your Apple Watch and needs no iPhone.

NO ADS, NO TRACKING
No accounts, no in-app purchases, no ads and no data collection. Just racing.

Requires watchOS 11 or later.
en.subtitle: 3D kart racing on your wrist
